summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new Admin -> Approvals import/sync toolbar tools (ApplicantImportTools). All 4 requested flows PASSED against the public preview URL. Login via /login with admin.qa credentials, panel switcher -> Admin, admin-tab-approvals, Driver Applications sub-tab. JSON import created 2 pending Website-lead drivers, CSV import created 1, dedup did NOT re-create the duplicates (count stayed the same), and Sync-from-email completed without errors.

integration_issues.issue: Sonner toast text could not be scraped via DOM ([class*='toast'], [role='status'], [data-sonner-toast]) — text returned empty for all 4 tests. The functional behavior of each toast (dialog closes, list refreshes, count updates) was verified end-to-end, so this is a test-harness limitation, not a product bug. If devs added a data-testid=applicants-import-toast / applicants-sync-toast wrapper it would be more robustly testable.

buttons_present_in_toolbar.location: Driver Applications toolbar, next to search + refresh

test4_sync_from_email.note: Sync brought in 1 record from the shared inbox during this run (may vary between runs).

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Add data-testid attributes on the toast container (e.g. applicants-import-toast, applicants-sync-toast) so QA can assert the exact 'Imported N applicant(s)' / 'skipped M duplicate(s)' / 'No new applications in the inbox' copy. Currently the text is not accessible via the standard Sonner DOM selectors used by automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Field normalization works well: fullName/name and phone/mobile aliases both accepted; the Beta record with only {name, mobile} was imported successfully.
Dedup by email/phone is effective — running the same JSON a second time added 0 new rows and produced no duplicate list items.
Import dialog closes automatically on success and the list reloads via onDone as designed in ApplicantImportTools.
Consider surfacing the exact created/skipped counts (created N, skipped M) more prominently — right now Sonner toasts dismiss quickly, and there is no audit log link visible in the toolbar.

Import tools sit in that sub-toolbar as [data-testid=applicants-sync-email-btn] and [data-testid=applicants-import-btn]. rca of the issue: N/A — all 4 requested flows pass. Only observation is a QA-ergonomics gap around Sonner toast text scraping (not a product bug).
